dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Linear trailing edge with zero curvature, representing a straight-line spline from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute vertex with minimal pixel radius, terminating in a sharp point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: High angular steepness, nearly vertical relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Narrow profile with a pixel base width approximately 0.3 times the vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, sharply tapered beak with a high thickness-to-length pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Definitive obtuse angle where the faceted melon slope meets the rostrum base.
